text: The anoscopy confirms the presence of internal hemorrhoids, which explains the painless rectal bleeding. Given the normal colonoscopy and the direct visualization of the hemorrhoids, I am confident in the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Internal Hemorrhoids
